text: The list of applicants and the relevant details of the applications are set out in the appended table.
The applicants complained under Article 11 of the Convention of the prohibition on holding peaceful assemblies.
The applicants complained under Article 11 of the Convention of restrictions on the location of public events.
The applicants complained under Article 11 of the Convention of restrictions on the time of conduct of public events.
The applicants complained under Article 11 of the Convention of restrictions on the manner of conduct of public events.
The applicants raised complaints under Article 13 of the Convention.
